docs_open.description: Open an existing Google Docs document and wait for its editor.

docs_read_text.description: Read the active Google document as plain text.

docs_set_title.description: Set the active Google document title and wait for save.

returns.description: Previous and current title with change and save status.

docs_append_text.description: Append plain text to the active Google document and verify it.

separator.description: Separator inserted before text in a non-empty document; defaults to a newline.

returns.description: Verified document text with change and save status.

docs_replace_all.description: Replace every plain-text match in the active Google document.

matchCase.description: Whether matching is case-sensitive; defaults to false.

returns.description: Verified text, replacement count, and save status.

sheets_open.description: Open an existing Google Sheets spreadsheet and wait for its grid.

sheets_get_sheet_names.description: List the visible sheet names in the active spreadsheet.

sheets_read_range.description: Read a Google Sheets A1 range as a two-dimensional array.

range.description: A1 range, optionally qualified by a sheet name.

returns.description: Displayed cell values as rows and columns.

sheets_write_range.description: Write and verify a rectangular matrix in a Google Sheets A1 range.

range.description: A1 range whose dimensions match values.

returns.description: Range, verified displayed values, and save status.

sheets_append_rows.description: Append rows after the last non-empty cell in column A of a named sheet.

values.description: Non-empty rectangular matrix of rows to append.

returns.description: Written range, verified displayed values, and save status.

gmail_open_inbox.description: Open the inbox for the active logged-in Gmail account.

gmail_list_threads.description: List structured summaries from the current Gmail thread list.

limit.description: Maximum number of threads from 1 to 100; defaults to 20.

returns.description: Thread summaries with id, sender, subject, snippet, date, and unread state.

gmail_search.description: Search Gmail and return structured thread summaries.

limit.description: Maximum number of threads from 1 to 100; defaults to 20.

gmail_read_thread.description: Open and read a Gmail thread from the current list.

id.description: Thread id returned by listGmailThreads or searchGmail.

returns.description: Thread subject and individual sender, date, and text messages.

gmail_create_draft.description: Create and save a Gmail draft without sending it.

to.description: Recipient email string or array of email strings.

cc.description: Optional Cc email string or array.

bcc.description: Optional Bcc email string or array.

body.description: Plain-text draft body; may be empty.

returns.description: Verified draft fields and drafted status; no message is sent.
